# Get all liked songs
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=login_result['access_token'], page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Liked songs count:", len(liked_songs))
print("Liked song IDs:", [song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs])
